# Mike Gonzalez — "Hollywood Mike G"

> Actor, producer, and Behavioral Agent Designer. SAG-AFTRA actor (Domino, Crank, The Way Back, Euphoria, East Los High, 9-1-1: Lone Star, Grimm, CSI: Miami) and originator of Relational Agent Design and the Driver ID format for persistent, private AI agents.

Mike Gonzalez (Hollywood Mike G) is a Los Angeles-based actor and producer represented by Artists United Agency LA, and the creator of Babycakes (WP-0001) — the first AI agent with a legal digital succession plan. He pioneered "Relational Agent Design," a method for building persistent, private AI agents through relationship rather than restriction.
